ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota daycare programs and follow the money to determine the extent of the fraud and those involved.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and investigating the allegations, we can determine the extent of the fraud and bring transparency to the daycare program.
